'''Intelligence Affiliate''' was the term used to describe independent agents working for the [[Galactic Alliance Fleet Intelligence]] service. In [[36 ABY]], [[Jae Juun]] and [[Tarfang]] were appointed as Intelligence Affiliates by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]].
